scenario: An operator-facing run detail route exposes raw retry-policy keys and queue tuning before the active run state, leaking backend configuration into the primary workflow.

review.summary: Backend configuration is competing with the operator's active-run task.
alternative_constraints: Make the active run the first object.
Keep tuning controls behind an explicit secondary context.

findings.title: Backend settings displace run state
findings.observation: The captured first viewport leads with retry policy and queue controls.
findings.product_mismatch: Operators need execution state before administrative configuration.

evidence.fact: Retry and queue fields occupy the top section while the active run is lower.

findings.revision_constraint: Do not solve by merely changing the controls' visual treatment.
